provider: InvenioRDM platform class — CaltechDATA, TU Graz, TU Wien, TalTech, KTH, Bamberg, MSD-Live

free_tier.stated: Per-record, NOT per-account: RDM_FILES_DEFAULT_QUOTA_SIZE = 10 GB and RDM_FILES_DEFAULT_MAX_FILE_SIZE = 10 GB, with APP_RDM_DEPOSIT_FORM_QUOTA maxFiles = 100. Records are unlimited. This is the structural inverse of Dataverse: InvenioRDM ships a real quota and it is per-object, so total space is unbounded while each record is capped at 10 GB.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

chaining: Excellent for the archive workload if registration were open, because 10 GB x unlimited records is unbounded in aggregate. It is not open on any instance tested.
limits_note: per-object-cap 10 GB/record and 10 GB/file, 100 files/record. No per-account cap exists in the platform, so no instance can report one.
reliability_note: All seven instances 404 on /signup/, which in InvenioRDM means SECURITY_REGISTERABLE is off; only Zenodo (already counted elsewhere) and the CERN demo return anything other than 404.
confidence_note: Unverified: carried from historical research records without live verification. A first-party page read confirms documentation.

extras.agent_focus: Systematic sweep of self-hosted academic repository software (Dataverse, DSpace, InvenioRDM, EPrints, Fedora/Islandora) scored on the four client questions: institutional-email requirement, per-file cap, per-collection/dataset cap, and whether the install enforces a quota object at all. Primary method was machine probing, not page reading: /api/info/version and /api/dataverses/:root/storage/quota?showInherited=true against the full official Dataverse installation registry (150 hostnames), the native-signup form probe /dataverseuser.xhtml?editMode=CREATE against all 83 no-quota hosts, and the platform source defaults read out of the upstream config files for DSpace, InvenioRDM, EPrints, libp2p and iroh. Secondary coverage of the relay/P2P half of the slot.

binding_note: the quota is real and unreachable: identity is the binding constraint, and it is not one of the six limits kinds
